forms.ex: Sie haben sich letztes Jahr scheiden lassen.
forms.exEn: They got divorced last year.

forms.ex: Nach der Scheidung ist er in eine kleine Wohnung gezogen.
forms.exEn: After the divorce he moved into a small flat.

forms.ex: Meine Eltern sind seit zehn Jahren geschieden.
forms.exEn: My parents have been divorced for ten years.

forms.en: decide (sich: make up your mind); decide on (a matter)
forms.clue: to decide, to make up your mind
forms.why: ent = away, apart: you separate one option from the others.
forms.ex: Ich kann mich zwischen den beiden Jacken nicht entscheiden.
forms.exEn: I can't decide between the two jackets.

forms.ex: Das war eine schwierige Entscheidung.
forms.exEn: That was a difficult decision.

forms.ex: Das ist der entscheidende Punkt.
forms.exEn: That is the crucial point.

forms.why: The Partizip II: someone who has decided is firm about it.
forms.ex: Sie hat den Vorschlag entschieden abgelehnt.
forms.exEn: She firmly rejected the proposal.

forms.en: undecided; drawn (a match that ends in a draw)
forms.note: Also a noun: das Unentschieden (a draw).
forms.ex: Das Spiel ist leider unentschieden ausgegangen.
forms.exEn: Unfortunately the match ended in a draw.

forms.why: unter = between (an old sense): you separate one thing from another.
forms.ex: Die Zwillinge kann man kaum unterscheiden.
forms.exEn: You can hardly tell the twins apart.

forms.note: The bare stem with the vowel of the past: scheid becomes schied.
forms.ex: Was ist der Unterschied zwischen den beiden Wörtern?
forms.exEn: What is the difference between the two words?

forms.clue: differing from one another (the adjective of 'the difference')
forms.ex: Die Meinungen sind sehr unterschiedlich.
forms.exEn: Opinions vary widely.

forms.clue: the act of telling apart, making a distinction
forms.ex: Die Unterscheidung zwischen Arbeit und Freizeit fällt mir schwer.
forms.exEn: I find it hard to draw a line between work and free time.

forms.ex: Die beiden Farben sind kaum unterscheidbar.
forms.exEn: The two colours can hardly be told apart.

forms.clue: various, all sorts of (kinds of bread, of people)
forms.why: Learn it as a word: once the Partizip II of verscheiden (to part, pass away), today simply 'different'.
forms.ex: In der Bäckerei gibt es verschiedene Sorten Brot.
forms.exEn: The bakery has various kinds of bread.

forms.en: Bescheid sagen = let someone know; Bescheid wissen = know (about it); (official) notice, decision
forms.clue: the (official) notice; ___ sagen = to let someone know
forms.why: Learn it as a word: from bescheiden (to inform, decide), the answer you are given; Bescheid sagen = let someone know.
forms.ex: Sag mir bitte Bescheid, wenn du ankommst.
forms.exEn: Please let me know when you arrive.

forms.why: Learn it as a word: once the participle of bescheiden (to allot), so content with what you are given.
forms.ex: Er ist trotz seines Erfolgs sehr bescheiden geblieben.
forms.exEn: Despite his success he has stayed very modest.

forms.ex: Seine Bescheidenheit macht ihn sehr sympathisch.
forms.exEn: His modesty makes him very likeable.

forms.why: ab = away + scheiden = part: parting from someone.
forms.ex: Der Abschied am Bahnhof war sehr traurig.
forms.exEn: Saying goodbye at the station was very sad.

forms.en: be knocked out, drop out (ist); leave (a post; ist); excrete (hat)
forms.clue: to be knocked out (of a contest)
forms.why: aus = out: you are separated out of the group.
forms.ex: Unsere Mannschaft ist in der ersten Runde ausgeschieden.
forms.exEn: Our team was knocked out in the first round.

forms.why: Learn it as a word: Schied is an old word for a settled dispute; the Richter (judge) who settles it.
forms.ex: Der Schiedsrichter hat das Tor nicht gegeben.
forms.exEn: The referee disallowed the goal.
